pr_title: Keep configuration of smtp_settings consistent between 6.1 and 7.0
pr_body:
### Summary

When configuring a new default for smtp_settings we ended up deleting the key from Rails.configuration.action_mailer.smtp_settings [here](https://github.com/rails/rails/commit/52db7f2ef3c4a902227cac163657c89282986e25#diff-b2555388d34f4657f98f10cd106ccac94433e322044fb9455724b09247984850R48-R50).

Ideally I think people should rely on ActionMailer::Base.smtp_settings instead of Rails.configuration.action_mailer.smtp_settings.

But in order to keep the same behavior as previous versions, this is an attempt to keep things as they were while adding the new defaults for smtp_timeouts.

Fixes #44059

issue_context.title: Behaviour of `smtp_settings` config has changed between Rails 6 to Rails 7
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce
I've created a repo here https://github.com/iCareWorld/rails-7-clobber-smtp-settings-example which outlines the problem in greater detail and provides a way of easily recreating the issue using Docker Compose.

### Overview
Rails 7 has introduced new behaviour that resets the `smtp_settings` of the Action Mailer config to `nil` when the `ActionMailer::Base` class is loaded.

### Expected behavior
Rails 7 would follow the same behaviour as Rails 6 or a note would be added to the changelog about the new behaviour.

### Actual behavior
When `ActionMailer::Base` is loaded, the `smtp_settings` of the action mailer config is set to nil. This breaks any further code which relies on values in these settings.

### Example output from the test repo:

#### Rails 6 (original behaviour)

```ruby
root@1c47d009f88c:/usr/src/app# rails c
Running via Spring preloader in process 32
Loading development environment (Rails 6.1.4.4)
irb(main):001:0> Rails.configuration.action_mailer.smtp_settings
=> {:domain=>"example.com"}
irb(main):002:0> ApplicationMailer
=> ApplicationMailer
irb(main):003:0> Rails.configuration.action_mailer.smtp_settings
=> {:domain=>"example.com"}
irb(main):004:0>
```

#### Rails 7 (new behaviour)
```ruby
root@d78adf052815:/usr/src/app# rails c
Loading development environment (Rails 7.0.0)
irb(main):001:0> Rails.configuration.action_mailer.smtp_settings
=> {:domain=>"example.com"}
irb(main):002:0> ApplicationMailer
=> ApplicationMailer
irb(main):003:0> Rails.configuration.action_mailer.smtp_settings
=> nil
irb(main):004:0>
```

### System configuration
**Rails version**: 7.00
**Ruby version**: 3.0.3

review_comments: We should not be mutating the `options` here. I think we can just avoid doing a delete a dup the options before passing.
This should only contain `domain` to keep the same behavior.

On 6.1 smtp_settings is passed down directly into ActionMailer from the config, and it's the same object. That's why I added this line. Maybe I'm missing something? 

```
Loading development environment (Rails 6.1.4.4)
irb(main):001:0> Rails.configuration.action_mailer.smtp_settings
=> {:domain=>"example.com"}
irb(main):002:0> ActionMailer::Base.smtp_settings
=> {:domain=>"example.com"}
irb(main):003:0> ActionMailer::Base.smtp_settings.object_id
=> 12100
irb(main):004:0> Rails.configuration.action_mailer.smtp_settings.object_id
=> 12100
irb(main):005:0> Rails.configuration.action_mailer.smtp_settings["foo"] = "bar"
=> "bar"
irb(main):006:0> ActionMailer::Base.smtp_settings
=> {:domain=>"example.com", "foo"=>"bar"}
```
